title: The ALMaQUEST Survey XI: a strong but non-linear relationship between star formation and dynamical equilibrium pressure
question: Does the resolved dynamical equilibrium pressure (P_DE) vs Sigma_SFR relation hold, and agree with the PRFM model, across a diverse sample of 66 galaxies including mergers and central starbursts, and is P_DE a more fundamental predictor of Sigma_SFR than Sigma_H2 or Sigma_star?

what.value: PIPE3D optical emission-line data cubes and surface densities (Sigma_star)

evidence.quote: Optical emission line fluxes are taken from the public PIPE3D data cubes (Sánchez et al. 2016a,b, 2018)

what.value: Integrated stellar masses and SFRs from the PIPE3D value-added catalog (sample table)

evidence.quote: presents their integrated stellar masses and SFRs taken from the PIPE3D (Sánchez et al., 2016a, 2016b) value-added catalog (VAC, Sánchez et al. 2018)

evidence.quote: the theoretical prediction of the PRFM model of Ostriker & Kim (2022), derived by fitting to the output of the high resolution TIGRESS simulation (their Equation 26c)

recipe.goal: Regrid ALMA CO cubes to MaNGA sampling
recipe.method: Trim ALMA cubes to MaNGA cube size, apply fixed 2.5 arcsec restoring beam with 0.5 arcsec pixels

recipe.goal: Convert CO luminosity to molecular gas surface density
recipe.method: Per-pixel L'(CO) converted to Sigma_H2 with a fixed alpha_CO, inclination corrected with b/a
key_parameters: alpha_CO = 4.3 Msun pc^-2 (K km/s)^-1 including helium
Alternative metallicity-dependent alpha_CO (Sun et al. 2020b) used only where 12+log(O/H) is available

recipe.goal: Derive Sigma_SFR and Sigma_star from MaNGA/PIPE3D
recipe.method: Halpha luminosities (extinction corrected) converted to Sigma_SFR with Kennicutt (1998) Eq. 2; Sigma_star from PIPE3D; Salpeter to Chabrier IMF conversion
key_parameters: Intrinsic Halpha/Hbeta = 2.85 with Milky Way extinction curve

recipe.goal: Select star-forming spaxels with CO detections
recipe.method: S/N>2 in four BPT lines, below Kauffmann et al. (2003) line, Halpha EW>6 A, and CO S/N>3

recipe.goal: Compute dynamical equilibrium pressure P_DE per spaxel
recipe.method: Sun et al. (2020a) P_DE formula with gas self-gravity and stellar gravity terms, using Sigma_gas = Sigma_H2 + Sigma_HI, stellar volume density from Sigma_star and R_star
assumptions: Isothermal plane-parallel gas and stellar disks; smooth disk (no clumping)

recipe.goal: Fit the four scaling relations (rSK, rMGMS, rSFMS, rPDE) and compare scatter
recipe.method: Orthogonal distance regression fits per sample, scatter around fit compared, and a free broken power law fitted to rPDE

recipe.goal: Compare rPDE with the PRFM prediction
recipe.method: Overplot the Ostriker & Kim (2022) PRFM relation on the spaxel data in the full, control, central starburst and merger samples

recipe.goal: Split by offset from the global SFMS (Delta SFR)
recipe.method: Compute Delta SFR vs a control sample matched in stellar mass, 5th nearest neighbour density and redshift; bin galaxies and compare rPDE per bin; median per-galaxy offset from the PRFM relation vs Delta SFR
key_parameters: Control matching tolerances: 0.1 dex mass, 0.1 dex 5th-NN density, 0.005 redshift

recipe.goal: Random forest ranking of predictors of Sigma_SFR
recipe.method: Random forest with Sigma_SFR as target and Sigma_H2, Sigma_star, P_DE (plus two combination variables and a random variable) as features; importances over 100 realizations
assumptions: Relative importances are only valid for the fixed feature set (sum to one)

recipe.goal: Test whether P_DE assumptions explain the PRFM discrepancy
recipe.method: Vary Sigma_HI, alpha_CO prescriptions, use measured CO velocity dispersion, remove extreme spaxels, and use the Hassan et al. (in prep) P_DE formula
key_parameters: Spaxel purges: line width > 20 km/s, Sigma_tot > 300 Msun pc^-2, within 2 kpc of galaxy centre

recipe.goal: Compare rPDE with the Krumholz et al. (2018) turbulence-driven model
recipe.method: Evaluate Sigma_SFR(P_DE) from the Krumholz et al. (2018) Toomre-timescale model with KMT+ molecular fraction for three orbital times and overplot on data

score_reason: Spaxel-level table is public and the P_DE, fitting and comparison recipe is mostly given, but ALMA processing is inherited from earlier papers and random forest and fitting details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: The derived spaxel table is released and the main results (ODR fits, scatter, broken power law break at 4.528, P_DE formula with fixed Sigma_HI and sigma) are numeric; the random forest ranking is only reproducible qualitatively.
